payload.title: Deploy from GitHub Actions with an OIDC role instead of manual cdk deploy
payload.description: Today the stack is deployed by hand with the legacy SSO profile. Add an IAM OIDC provider/role for this repo and a deploy workflow (cdk diff on PRs, deploy after a release), modeled on Chatticus's github-deploy-stack. Also set branch protection on develop and main requiring specs, commitlint, typecheck.
